ops.name: mulWad
ops.notice: x y / 10^18 rounded down, exactly: in one word while x y fits (as Solady's mulWad, which reverts past it), else from the exact 512-bit product P, floor(P / 10^18) = ((P - P mod 10^18) / 2^18) times the inverse of 5^18 modulo 2^256. Reverts only when the result does not fit.
ops.domain: any x, y whose result fits uint256
ops.reverts: MulWadFailed() when x y / 10^18 does not fit uint256

ops.name: mulWadUp
ops.notice: x y / 10^18 rounded up, exactly, as mulWad.
ops.domain: any x, y whose result fits uint256
ops.reverts: MulWadFailed() when x y / 10^18 rounded up does not fit uint256

ops.name: mulWadDown
ops.notice: mulWad: x y / 10^18 rounded down.
ops.domain: any x, y whose result fits uint256
ops.reverts: MulWadFailed() when x y / 10^18 does not fit uint256

ops.name: divWad
ops.notice: x 10^18 / y rounded down, exactly: in one word while x 10^18 fits (Solady reverts past it), else Remco Bloemen's mulDiv on the exact 512-bit numerator. Reverts only for y = 0 or a result that does not fit.
ops.domain: y != 0 and a result that fits uint256
ops.reverts: DivWadFailed() for y = 0 or a result past uint256

ops.name: divWadUp
ops.notice: x 10^18 / y rounded up, exactly, as divWad.
ops.domain: y != 0 and a result that fits uint256
ops.reverts: DivWadFailed() for y = 0 or a result past uint256

ops.name: divWadDown
ops.notice: divWad: x 10^18 / y rounded down.
ops.domain: y != 0 and a result that fits uint256
ops.reverts: DivWadFailed() for y = 0 or a result past uint256

ops.name: sMulWad
ops.notice: x y / 10^18 rounded toward zero, as Solady's sdiv rounds it (its comment says down; its code truncates), exactly: in one word while x y fits, else from the magnitudes' 512-bit product as mulWad. Reverts only when the result does not fit.
ops.domain: any x, y whose result fits int256
ops.reverts: SMulWadFailed() when the result does not fit int256

ops.name: sMulWadDown
ops.notice: x y / 10^18 rounded toward minus infinity, exactly, as sMulWad: the truncated quotient less one when the remainder is negative.
ops.domain: any x, y whose result fits int256
ops.reverts: SMulWadFailed() when the result does not fit int256

ops.name: sMulWadUp
ops.notice: x y / 10^18 rounded toward plus infinity, exactly, as sMulWad: the truncated quotient plus one when the remainder is positive.
ops.domain: any x, y whose result fits int256
ops.reverts: SMulWadFailed() when the result does not fit int256

ops.name: sDivWad
ops.notice: x 10^18 / y rounded toward zero, as Solady's sdiv rounds it, exactly: in one word while x 10^18 fits (it is never -2^255, so sdiv cannot overflow), else mulDiv on the magnitudes' exact numerator (wadsdiv). Reverts only for y = 0 or a result that does not fit.
ops.domain: y != 0 and a result that fits int256
ops.reverts: SDivWadFailed() for y = 0 or a result past int256

ops.name: sDivWadDown
ops.notice: x 10^18 / y rounded toward minus infinity, exactly, as sDivWad.
ops.domain: y != 0 and a result that fits int256
ops.reverts: SDivWadFailed() for y = 0 or a result past int256

ops.name: sDivWadUp
ops.notice: x 10^18 / y rounded toward plus infinity, exactly, as sDivWad.
ops.domain: y != 0 and a result that fits int256
ops.reverts: SDivWadFailed() for y = 0 or a result past int256

ops.name: sqrtWad
ops.notice: sqrt(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded down, exactly: the integer root of x 10^18, below 2^254 by FP256's word root (isqrt) on the product shifted by an even 2j to put its top bit at 252 or 253, shifted back by j (the floor of the floor of sqrt(4^j n) over 2^j is the floor of sqrt(n)); above, wadsqrtw.

ops.name: sqrtWadUp
ops.notice: sqrt(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded up, exactly.

ops.name: sqrtWadDown
ops.notice: sqrtWad: sqrt(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded down.

ops.name: cbrtWad
ops.notice: cbrt(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded down: the integer cube root of the exact x 10^36, from FP256's root and one exact cube either way.

ops.name: cbrtWadUp
ops.notice: cbrt(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded up.

ops.name: cbrtWadDown
ops.notice: cbrtWad: cbrt(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded down.

ops.name: expWad
ops.notice: e^(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded down: zero at and below -41446531673892822313, where the value is under one wei.
ops.reverts: ExpOverflow() from x = 135305999368893231590 (Solady: from ...589, one wei earlier, whose value still fits)

ops.name: expWadUp
ops.notice: e^(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded up: one wei, never zero, below -41446531673892822312.

ops.name: expWadDown
ops.notice: expWad: e^(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded down.

ops.name: lnWad
ops.notice: ln(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded down (toward minus infinity, as Solady's sar rounds it).

ops.name: lnWadUp
ops.notice: ln(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded up.

ops.name: lnWadDown
ops.notice: lnWad: ln(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded down.

ops.name: log2Wad
ops.notice: log2(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded down, as lnWad. Solady has no WAD log2 (its log2 is the integer one).

ops.name: log2WadUp
ops.notice: log2(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded up.

ops.name: log2WadDown
ops.notice: log2Wad: log2(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded down.

ops.name: log10Wad
ops.notice: log10(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded down, as lnWad; exact at powers of ten.

ops.name: log10WadUp
ops.notice: log10(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded up.

ops.name: log10WadDown
ops.notice: log10Wad: log10(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded down.

ops.name: powWad
ops.notice: (x 10^-18)^(y 10^-18) in WAD rounded down, the exact power: Solady composes expWad(lnWad(x) y / 10^18) and reverts at x = 0; here 0^0 = 10^18 and 0^y = 0 for y > 0, as PRBMath's pow.
ops.domain: x >= 0 (0^y for y >= 0); a result below 2^255
ops.reverts: LnWadUndefined() for x < 0 and for x = 0 with y < 0; ExpOverflow() when the result reaches 2^255

ops.name: powWadUp
ops.notice: (x 10^-18)^(y 10^-18) in WAD rounded up.
ops.domain: x >= 0 (0^y for y >= 0); a result below 2^255
ops.reverts: LnWadUndefined() for x < 0 and for x = 0 with y < 0; ExpOverflow() when the result reaches 2^255

ops.name: powWadDown
ops.notice: powWad: (x 10^-18)^(y 10^-18) in WAD rounded down.
ops.domain: x >= 0 (0^y for y >= 0); a result below 2^255
ops.reverts: LnWadUndefined() for x < 0 and for x = 0 with y < 0; ExpOverflow() when the result reaches 2^255

ops.name: lambertW0Wad
ops.notice: W0(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded toward zero, as Solady's sdiv rounds it: the principal branch, w e^w = x 10^-18, w >= -1.

ops.name: lambertW0WadDown
ops.notice: W0(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded toward minus infinity.

ops.name: lambertW0WadUp
ops.notice: W0(x 10^-18) in WAD rounded toward plus infinity.

ops.name: exp
ops.notice: PRBMath's name for expWad (SD59x18 exp): e^(x 10^-18) rounded down.

ops.name: ln
ops.notice: PRBMath's name for lnWad (SD59x18 ln): ln(x 10^-18) rounded down.

ops.name: pow
ops.notice: PRBMath's name for powWad (SD59x18 pow): rounded down.
ops.domain: x >= 0 (0^y for y >= 0); a result below 2^255
ops.reverts: LnWadUndefined() for x < 0 and for x = 0 with y < 0; ExpOverflow() when the result reaches 2^255
